name: Files With System DLL Name In Unsuspected Locations
description:
Detects the creation of a file with the ".dll" extension that has the name of a System DLL in uncommon or unsuspected locations. (Outisde of "System32", "SysWOW64", etc.).
It is highly recommended to perform an initial baseline before using this rule in production.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Third party software might bundle specific versions of system DLLs.
query: (file.path:(*\\secur32.dll OR *\\tdh.dll)) AND (NOT (file.path:(*C\:\\$WINDOWS.\~BT\\* OR *C\:\\$WinREAgent\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\SoftwareDistribution\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\uus\\*)))
